rows.text: Ziatora turns one spare Goblin into three Treasures every turn. At each of your end steps you may sacrifice another creature: Ziatora deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target, and you make three Treasures. Most turns that's a 1/1 token for 1 damage and three mana — ramp you get to keep. The big turn is different: pumps that last "until end of turn" are still on at your end step, so after an attack with Shared Animosity, sacrifice your biggest attacker and Ziatora throws all of it.
The deck also goes infinite three ways — see the combos.
The Goblin engine doesn't need Ziatora. Krenko, Siege-Gang and the token spells run on their own; Ziatora arrives on turn four or five off the ramp and starts paying out.

rows.name: Ziatora, the Incinerator
rows.text: a 6/6 flier. At each of your end steps: sacrifice another creature, deal damage equal to its power anywhere, make three Treasures.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: shroud the turn Ziatora lands, and haste for Krenko. Never equip it to Kiki-Jiki — shroud stops Zealous Conscripts or Restoration Angel from targeting Kiki.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free while Ziatora is on the battlefield; send their removal elsewhere.

rows.name: Nim Deathmantle + Ashnod's Altar + Beetleback Chief
rows.text: whenever a nontoken creature dies, pay {4} to return it wearing the Deathmantle. Beetleback comes back with two Goblins; sacrifice all three to the Altar for six mana, and four of it pays for the next lap. Siege-Gang Commander nets more, Mogg War Marshal nets two (let its death token arrive first), Goblin Instigator breaks even and still loops. The returned creature is a black Zombie, not a Goblin, so it goes to the Altar. Every lap is three deaths for Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat and Mayhem Devil, plus a Treasure from Pitiless Plunderer.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: Kiki copies Conscripts, and the copy's enter trigger untaps Kiki — target Kiki itself. Repeat for as many hasty 3/3s as you want, the same turn Kiki lands (it has haste). Impact Tremors and General Kreat turn every copy into damage; Goblin Bombardment throws them. Never leave Lightning Greaves on Kiki: shroud stops the Conscripts copy targeting it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: Kiki copies the Crafter. The copy's champion trigger exiles Kiki; the hasty copy taps for 3 damage; sacrifice it to Goblin Bombardment; Kiki returns untapped — it has haste — and copies the Crafter again. Unlimited 3-damage shots, so this one kills on its own. Ashnod's Altar and Skirk Prospector work as the outlet too. The original Crafter must stay on the battlefield; when it enters you must exile another Goblin or Shaman (champion) or sacrifice it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Thornbite Staff + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: the Staff attaches itself to Kiki when Kiki enters after it (otherwise equip costs {4}). Kiki copies any nonlegendary creature, you sacrifice a creature to Goblin Bombardment, and the death untaps Kiki. Unlimited loops.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Conspicuous Snoop
rows.text: Recruiter puts Kiki on TOP of your library. Snoop has every activated ability of the Goblin on top, so it copies itself with Kiki's ability — and every hasty copy does the same. Snoop needs haste or a turn in play to start, and most copies end up tapped, so finish with Goblin Bombardment or Impact Tremors. Outside the combo, Snoop lets you cast Goblins straight off the top of your library.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Thornbite Staff + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: equip the Staff to Krenko ({4} — he's a Warrior, so it won't attach itself). Krenko taps for a Goblin per Goblin; sacrifice one to Skirk Prospector; the death untaps Krenko; tap again. The army doubles every lap. Win with Impact Tremors, General Kreat, Zulaport Cutthroat or Blood Artist.
Careful with Korvold out: it draws a card for every sacrifice, and drawing is not optional. Count your library and stop a loop before it empties — the drains have usually finished the table by then.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: when you already hold Zealous Conscripts, Lightning Crafter or the Staff — Kiki is the piece that turns half a combo into a kill.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: when you're missing two or more pieces. Matron gets Recruiter; Recruiter stacks the rest on top of your library.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: when Thornbite Staff is already out, or when you simply need a board this turn.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Lightning Crafter
rows.text: when Kiki-Jiki is on the battlefield and you have a free outlet — the Crafter is the last piece.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Skirk Prospector
rows.text: when the combo is assembled but nothing will sacrifice for free.

rows.name: Demonic Tutor -> Nim Deathmantle
rows.text: the combo piece no Goblin tutor can find; take Ashnod's Altar if the Deathmantle is already out.

rows.name: Eldritch Evolution -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: sacrifice a three-drop — Pashalik Mons or a spent Goblin Matron — and Kiki or Zealous Conscripts goes straight onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Chord of Calling -> Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: instant speed, for the non-Goblin half; convoke lets your Goblins pay.

rows.name: Diabolic Intent -> Thornbite Staff
rows.text: sacrifice a token for whichever piece is missing.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Ringleader + Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: choose a four-card hand refill or a six-creature deployment. The exact piles and draw sequencing are below; either payoff works without the commander.

guide.title: Goblin Recruiter setups — what to stack, top card first

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Goblin Ringleader; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Goblin Warchief. Draw or otherwise reach Ringleader, then cast it: its entry trigger puts the next four selected Goblins into your hand. Those creatures still need to be cast; Ringleader does not deploy them. If Ringleader is already in hand, start the pile with the four targets instead.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Muxus, Goblin Grandee; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Goblin Warchief; Goblin Ringleader; Hexing Squelcher. Reach and cast Muxus; all six following cards are Goblin creatures with mana value five or less, so its entry trigger puts them onto the battlefield. If Muxus is already in hand, omit it from the pile and reveal the six immediately.

rows.name: Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: Put these four cards immediately UNDER the six-card Muxus package: Krenko, Mob Boss; Goblin Matron; Siege-Gang Commander; Sling-Gang Lieutenant. When Muxus deploys Ringleader, the entry trigger puts this backup package into your hand. Resolve Ringleader before any other draw triggers and before the original Lightning Crafter's champion trigger. Only stack cards still in your library; substitute useful Goblins for pieces already in hand or on the battlefield.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: The original Crafter champions the Recruiter that made the pile, or the Ringleader AFTER its refill resolves. Keep Kiki and Prospector on the battlefield. Tap Kiki to copy Crafter; the hasty copy champions Kiki, taps for 3 damage, then is sacrificed to Prospector for {R}. Kiki returns untapped with haste. Repeat for lethal damage and red mana. No combat or commander is required, but removal or effects that stop the entry triggers/activated abilities can interrupt it.

rows.name: Goblin Warchief
rows.text: Included on the Muxus board to give your other Goblins haste and reduce the generic cost of backup Goblin spells. Kiki and its copies already have haste; Warchief is for Krenko and the wider recovery plan.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: The Muxus pile supplies ward for the other creatures and makes later spells uncounterable. Entering with Muxus does not protect the Muxus spell retroactively; when you need that protection, cast Squelcher before Muxus.

Conspicuous Snoop can cast the top Goblin payoff directly. Necropotence skips your draw; use one activation to take the top payoff at the next end step, or an explicitly counted draw effect. Korvold draws whenever you sacrifice, so do not sacrifice through Prospector to pay for Muxus while a precisely arranged pile is waiting unless you accounted for those draws.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: The existing Snoop line remains: with Conspicuous Snoop able to tap and a damage/sacrifice payoff available, leave Kiki on top to grant Snoop the copy ability. Choose this pile instead of the Muxus/Ringleader pile when Snoop already has the win.

Searches that shuffle undo the pile: use fetch lands and other tutors BEFORE Recruiter. Any extra draw, mill or exile also changes the positions; account for it before committing. Muxus only puts eligible Goblin CREATURES onto the battlefield: Goblin-typed instants/enchantments and Muxus itself are not hits. Recruiter does not put the payoff in your hand for free.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: taps for a 1/1 per Goblin you control — the army doubles each turn.

rows.name: Siege-Gang Commander
rows.text: three Goblins when it enters; {1}{R} and a sacrifice deal 2 damage.

rows.name: Beetleback Chief
rows.text: two Goblins when it enters.

rows.name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
rows.text: two hasty Goblins each of your combats while Ziatora is on the battlefield.

rows.name: Howlsquad Heavy
rows.text: a Goblin each of your combats, and haste for your other Goblins.

rows.name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
rows.text: a Goblin when your Goblins attack, and 1 damage to each opponent for every other creature that enters.

rows.name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
rows.text: two Goblins when it enters; sacrifice a Goblin to drain a player for 1.

rows.name: Goblin Instigator
rows.text: two bodies for two mana.

rows.name: Mogg War Marshal
rows.text: a Goblin when it enters and another when it dies.

rows.name: Boggart Mischief
rows.text: two Goblins when it enters (by putting a −1/−1 counter on one of your creatures); after that, each of your Goblins that dies drains every opponent for 1.

rows.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker
rows.text: a Goblin that makes Treasure when it attacks, then a card filter, then Reflection of Kiki-Jiki — a copy maker that costs {1} each use and needs a turn before it can tap.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: a hasty copy each turn — Siege-Gang Commander is four creatures every turn.

rows.name: Goblin Chieftain
rows.text: other Goblins +1/+1 and haste.

rows.name: Goblin Warchief
rows.text: Goblins cost one less and have haste.

rows.name: Blood Artist
rows.text: any creature that dies drains a player for 1.

rows.name: Zulaport Cutthroat
rows.text: each of your creatures that dies drains every opponent for 1.

rows.name: Mayhem Devil
rows.text: 1 damage whenever ANY player sacrifices a permanent — including every Treasure Ziatora gives you.

rows.name: Pashalik Mons
rows.text: 1 damage whenever one of your Goblins dies; {3}{R} and a sacrifice make two new Goblins.

rows.name: Boggart Cursecrafter
rows.text: deathtouch, and each of your other Goblins that dies deals 1 to each opponent.

rows.name: Pitiless Plunderer
rows.text: a Treasure whenever another creature of yours dies — Ziatora's sacrifice makes four.

rows.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
rows.text: a card and a +1/+1 counter for every permanent you sacrifice — creatures and Treasures alike.

rows.name: Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: sacrifice a creature for 1 damage anywhere.

rows.name: Skirk Prospector
rows.text: sacrifice a Goblin for {R}.

rows.name: Phyrexian Tower
rows.text: a land that sacrifices a creature for {B}{B}.

rows.name: Ashnod's Altar
rows.text: sacrifice a creature for {C}{C}.

rows.name: Deadly Dispute
rows.text: sacrifice a creature or artifact — a Treasure counts: two cards and a Treasure back.

rows.name: Professional Face-Breaker
rows.text: a Treasure for each player your creatures deal combat damage to, and Treasures become cards.

rows.name: Tireless Provisioner
rows.text: a Food or Treasure for every land you play.

rows.name: Shared Animosity
rows.text: each attacking Goblin gets +1/+0 for each other attacking Goblin — and that's still on at your end step, when Ziatora sacrifices the biggest one.

rows.name: Impact Tremors
rows.text: 1 to each opponent for every creature that enters.

rows.name: Necropotence
rows.text: skip your draw, pay 1 life per card; the drains give it back.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: equip it to a creature with 1 toughness and it dies: two cards for one mana. A lord that adds toughness keeps your tokens alive, so pick an X/1.

rows.name: Black Market Connections
rows.text: each first main phase: a Treasure for 1 life, a card for 2, a 3/2 changeling — a Goblin — for 3.

rows.name: Sylvan Library
rows.text: see three cards every turn — but it uses your draw step, which Necropotence skips, so don't lean on both.

rows.name: Gaea's Cradle
rows.text: a green mana for every creature you control.

rows.name: Ignoble Hierarch
rows.text: black, red or green on turn one — and it's a Goblin.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: a one-mana source of any colour.

rows.name: Llanowar Elves
rows.text: a one-mana green source.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the fastest start.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: any of your three colours.

rows.name: Nature's Lore
rows.text: a Forest dual onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Three Visits
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Farseek
rows.text: a Swamp or Mountain dual onto the battlefield tapped.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: name Goblin: {2} and a tap make a mana for every Goblin you control.

rows.name: Cavern of Souls
rows.text: name Goblin: they can't be countered.

rows.name: Terminate
rows.text: two mana, no regeneration.

rows.name: Assassin's Trophy
rows.text: any permanent an opponent controls.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm
rows.text: a creature or enchantment; you lose life equal to its mana value.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with Ziatora on the battlefield.

rows.name: Beast Within
rows.text: any permanent; they get a 3/3.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the red answer to anything.

rows.name: Boseiju, Who Endures
rows.text: a land that destroys an artifact, enchantment or nonbasic land.

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: hexproof and indestructible for everything.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: your spells can't be countered, and every other creature you control has "ward — pay 2 life."

rows.name: Veil of Summer
rows.text: one mana: your spells can't be countered this turn, and your permanents gain hexproof from blue and black.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep two or three lands, a mana creature or ramp spell, and a Goblin maker. Build the board first; Ziatora comes down when it can start sacrificing right away.
Every one of your end steps with Ziatora out, sacrifice something — the three Treasures are the point, even when the damage is only 1.
Save the big sacrifice for the turn Shared Animosity pumps an attack, or for a creature that's about to die anyway.
